_comment: Outro copy, as weighted variants so the CTA can be A/B tested later.
Each variant is rendered ONCE to assets/outro/<id>.mp4 and reused for
every video that draws it. Selection is per video; SYNTHESIS is not.
Any change to `spoken` invalidates that variant's cache and costs one
TTS call (~40 chars, ~$0.009) the next time it is selected.
`weight` is relative, not a percentage. Set a weight to 0 to retire a
variant without deleting it or renumbering the others.
`spoken` is what the voice says; `line_1`/`line_2` are what appears on
screen. They are deliberately separate: the URL reads better split onto
its own line visually, but must be spoken as one phrase.
